title: On the Bergman metric of symmetric spaces
summary: We study bounded domains $Ω\subset\mathbb{C}^n$ whose Bergman metric is locally symmetric, i.e. its Riemannian curvature tensor is parallel with respect to the Levi-Civita connection. Following the strategy developed in \cite{UnifThm2}, we obtain two rigidity results. If the Bergman metric of $Ω$ is complete, then $Ω$ is (globally) symmetric. If instead $Ω$ is pseudoconvex, then $Ω$ is biholomorphic to $\widetildeΩ\setminus E$, where $\widetildeΩ\subset\mathbb{C}^n$ is a bounded symmetric domain and $E\subset\widetildeΩ$ is relatively closed and pluripolar.
